title: eat shit & die 186
author: bpatrick
body: I tried to limit my use of the airbrush tool so as to avoid the halloween-mask-effect. I think it turned out OK.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: Yeah Onan! Really would like to see more. Will buy the graphic novel when its done.

comments.author: AJ
comments.text:
I second that I want a real copy of all your comics
fuck it if SMBC has one why don’t you?

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: Just awesome coloring on this one; well done.

comments.author: Phil C.
comments.text:
“Purple-headed monster”, bwahahahahahaha. Awesome, man.

Keep writing and drawing!

cheers,
Phil

comments.author: DarkCanuck
comments.text: Yeah! Onan! I think I’m with Mr. Paycheck on this, Onan is probably my favourite storyline.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: I wonder who enjoys reading these comments more: b or me? I’m so glad there is such a large audience in favor of Onan comics. I remember when b worried that nobody would like Onan and I worried that I was the only one who did. Thanks for proving us wrong guys!

comments.author: kidz
comments.text: dude how did i not know about you until now? i just read through all 186 of yours just now… u are sick! keep up the great work!

comments.author: marshall
comments.text:
I like the unblended and hard-edged color shades far more than when smoothed (like on your about page). Just my personal opinion.

Anyhow first post here, I’ve read all the comics on this site and they are far more meaningful than most anything else i read. I don’t think you give yourself nearly enough credit.

comments.author: steve
comments.text: I wish you could quit your job and make comics full time! I crave more curious!

comments.author: David
comments.text: Yes! This is great! Good to see Onan’s got his priorities straight..

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: kidz, you will be pleased to know that akimbo comics is more than just es&d. Just look on the sidebar under “Categories” for all the different albums of comics that b patrick has graced us with. 🙂

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: Aw man you teased us with 3 updates in 4 days, but now only 1 update in the last 2 weeks. I’m going through withdrawals!

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: b will do that to you… I try to be patient with him, because his comics are that good, but sometimes I want to chain him to his desk and hire a guy to drip hot oil on his head if he doesn’t draw anything.

comments.author: kittencontinues
comments.text: Awesome story and the colors are sweet, really like the last panel.

comments.author: Haemoglobin Juniour
comments.text: I love the sea and sun in the first panel. That place looks peaceful.
